messages:
Alex Monroe: Quick sticky 15 min tech check before the all-hands. Can someone confirm recorder health?
Rina Shah: I'll run a quick ingest test and post results here.
Oliver - AV: Roomb battery at 72%, mics patched, backup lavs in kit. Doing a 10s audio loop test now.
Hannah (Comms): Reminder: leadership Q&A will take live questions and written follow-ups. Please drop questions in this thread.
Jae - Product: Heads-up for the roadmap segment: we'll need to skip the deep-dives to stay on schedule. Can we add a post-meeting deep-dive slot?
Alex Monroe: Good call. Scheduling 30-min follow-up after all-hands for product deep-dive.
InfraBot: :information_source: Stream ingest endpoint health: 99.98% over last 24h. No throttles.
Rina Shah: Ingest test: 8fps packet loss 0.3%, audio levels -4dB. Passing.
Oliver - AV: If presenters hit black screen, swap to DP input and trigger the "fallback-slide" scene in OBS.
Alex Monroe: Can someone flag if captions lag >5s during live? We'll pause Q&A to resolve.
Hannah (Comms): Noted. Also publishing slides to shared folder immediately after event.
Jae - Product: Question for leadership (dropping here): Will the Dedicated burst policy include per-customer rate limits?
Alex Monroe: We'll ask ops/product live. If unanswered, we'll capture and follow up.
Oliver - AV: One last note 10 spare HDMI cables in case of EDID issues.
Hannah (Comms): Tech check in 5. Please be present in green room or this thread.
Alex Monroe: Thanks everyone 15:55 check begins now.
